lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So I've been thinking, this summer instead of our usual holiday rental,
lines.translation: 所以我一直在想 今年夏天 而不是我们通常的假日租约

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A camper van?
lines.translation: 露营车？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You mean to spend the summer living out of a car?
lines.translation: 你的意思是整个夏天都住在车里？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, a camper van.
lines.translation: 是的,一辆野营车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And no, it's nothing like living out of a car.
lines.translation: 不,这跟住在车里没什么两样

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These are proper vans with full-size beds to sleep in.
lines.translation: 这些是适当的面包车,有整尺寸的床睡觉。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some even have kitchens.
lines.translation: 有些人甚至有厨房。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This way, we wouldn't have to be locked into one place during our holiday.
lines.translation: 这样,我们不必在节假日 被锁在一个地方

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We'd be able to visit so many more places and travel at our own pace.
lines.translation: 我们可以去更多地方 以我们自己的速度旅行

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The rates of most hotels and holiday homes really soar in the summer anyway.
lines.translation: 大部分酒店和度假屋的收费率 在夏天真的飞快反正。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We'd probably save a lot of money as well.
lines.translation: 我们可能也会省很多钱

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I think my grandfather had a van like that.
lines.translation: 我觉得我爷爷以前就有一辆那样的车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It doesn't sound that appealing to me.
lines.translation: 听起来对我没那么有吸引力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Today's camper vans are completely different.
lines.translation: 现在的露营车完全不一样了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These days, they're equipped with all the modern comforts.
lines.translation: 如今，它们都配备了各种现代化的舒适设施。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've seen quite a few with solar panels that provide electricity for when you're stopped.
lines.translation: 我见过不少装有太阳能电池板的露营车，停车时可以用来供电。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This way, you can still use your computer or charge your phone.
lines.translation: 这样你仍然可以使用电脑或给手机充电。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And most even have Wi-Fi, so if the weather's not great, you could stream videos.
lines.translation: 而且大多数车甚至还配有 Wi-Fi，所以如果天气不太好，你还可以在线看视频。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm warming up to the idea.
lines.translation: 我开始有点接受这个想法了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Keep talking.
lines.translation: 继续说。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Loads of people are committing to this trend full time.
lines.translation: 现在有很多人全职投入这种生活方式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Check it out online.
lines.translation: 你可以上网看看。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Lots of people stream videos of their alternative lifestyles and actually earn a salary.
lines.translation: 很多人把自己的另类生活方式拍成视频直播，实际上还能赚到工资。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Imagine having that kind of freedom to go anywhere you want and work from anywhere in the world.
lines.translation: 想想看，要是能拥有那样的自由，想去哪儿就去哪儿，还能在世界任何地方工作，那该多好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, we can consider it.
lines.translation: 好吧，我们可以考虑一下。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As long as the basic needs like toilet and showers are covered, I'm definitely in.
lines.translation: 只要厕所和淋浴之类的基本需求能得到满足，我肯定参加。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Do you think there will be enough room for my mountain bike?
lines.translation: 你觉得我的山地车有足够的地方放吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What about food delivery?
lines.translation: 那食物配送呢？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Will we be able to order at the van?
lines.translation: 我们能在露营车这里点外卖吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Will there be enough space for the dog?
lines.translation: 狗狗有足够的空间吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We wouldn't want to leave him behind.
lines.translation: 我们可不想把它丢在家里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Slow down.
lines.translation: 别急。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Glad you're excited about it.
lines.translation: 很高兴你这么兴奋。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Let's start by looking at what's available first.
lines.translation: 我们先看看现在有哪些选择吧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 1-4 are based on the conversation you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题1 -4是基于你刚才听到的谈话

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.translation: 1. 国家

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What has the woman been thinking of doing for this summer?
lines.translation: 这个女人今年夏天想做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 2.
lines.translation: 问题2

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What do we learn about the man's grandfather from the conversation?
lines.translation: 我们从谈话中了解到什么 关于他祖父的事?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 3.
lines.translation: 问题3

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What can many campervans do nowadays according to the woman?
lines.translation: 女人们说,现在许多野营车能做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question four.
lines.translation: 问题4。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What idea does the woman find attractive?
lines.translation: 那个女人觉得什么吸引人?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation two.
lines.translation: 对话二

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You wanted to see me?
lines.translation: 你找我？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, I'll get straight to the point.
lines.translation: 是的，我就直说了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Over the past month or so, it has become apparent that your performance has dipped.
lines.translation: 过去一个月左右，很明显你的工作表现有所下滑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You've been late to work several times these past few weeks, which is very uncharacteristic of you.
lines.translation: 最近几周你迟到过好几次，这很不像平时的你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But what really concerns me is your curtailed output.
lines.translation: 但真正让我担心的是你的工作产出减少了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Lately, you seem to be constantly one step behind.
lines.translation: 最近你似乎总是慢人一步。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What's going on?
lines.translation: 到底怎么回事？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm sorry.
lines.translation: 对不起。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm going through some unfortunate family issues at the moment.
lines.translation: 我最近正面临一些不幸的家庭问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's a personal matter, so if you don't mind, I much prefer we don't get into it.
lines.translation: 这是私事，所以如果你不介意的话，我很希望我们不要谈这个。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nevertheless, I expect it to have all blown over in another month or so.
lines.translation: 不过，我预计再过一个月左右，一切应该就会平息下来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Do you need some time off?
lines.translation: 你需要请一段时间假吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Actually, yes.
lines.translation: 其实，是的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Would it be possible to take the next two Mondays off?
lines.translation: 下两个星期一我可以请假吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I was deliberating whether I should ask for this, but now that we're here…
lines.translation: 我之前一直在犹豫要不要提出这个请求，不过既然我们现在谈到这儿了……

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sure thing.
lines.translation: 当然可以。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But if you needed some leave, why didn't you ask for it earlier?
lines.translation: 但如果你需要休假，为什么不早点申请呢？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm not sure why.
lines.translation: 我也不知道为什么。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I guess I kind of felt bad asking for it.
lines.translation: 我想我只是觉得提出休假请求不太好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You shouldn't feel bad asking for leave, especially if you need it.
lines.translation: 你不应该因为请假而感到不好意思，尤其是在你确实需要休假的时候。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I know.
lines.translation: 我知道。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You're right.
lines.translation: 你说得对。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm sorry.
lines.translation: 对不起。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Look, you've been with us almost five years and I personally really value your proficiency at your job.
lines.translation: 听着，你在我们这儿工作快五年了，而我个人确实非常看重你的工作能力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It makes my job far easier.
lines.translation: 这让我的工作轻松多了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In addition, I can assure you that management as a whole also holds you in high regard.
lines.translation: 另外，我可以向你保证，管理层整体上也非常认可你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.translation: 谢谢。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What I need is for you to be back at your 100%.
lines.translation: 我需要的是你恢复到百分之百的状态。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are you sure taking two Mondays off will suffice?
lines.translation: 你确定只休两个星期一就够了吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It'll be enough.
lines.translation: 够了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm sure of it.
lines.translation: 我确定。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, good.
lines.translation: 好吧,好。 不错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So this is what we're going to do.
lines.translation: 这就是我们要做的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You will take those days off, and I expect that you will gradually come back to your usual self.
lines.translation: 你将休息这些日子,我期望你将逐渐回到你平常的状态。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then in two months' time, we will catch up again to see how you are faring.
lines.translation: 然后两个月后,我们将再次赶上来看你过得如何。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sounds good.
lines.translation: 听起来不错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding.
lines.translation: 谢谢你的理解。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions five to eight are based on the conversation you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题5到8 是基于你刚才听到的谈话

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 5.
lines.translation: 问题5

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What do we learn about the woman from the man's description?
lines.translation: 我们从男人的描述中 了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 6.
lines.translation: 问题6

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does the woman say she's experiencing at the moment?
lines.translation: 那个女人怎么说她现在经历什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 7.
lines.translation: 问题7

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does the man say makes his job far easier?
lines.translation: 他说什么能让他的工作容易得多?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.translation: 8. 预 算

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What agreement have the speakers reached by the end of the conversation?
lines.translation: 在对话结束时,发言者达成了什么协议?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Section B.
lines.translation: B节。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section, you will hear two passages.
lines.translation: 在本节中,你将听到两段。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each passage, will hear three or four questions.
lines.translation: 每段结尾处将听取三个或四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 发言的通过和提问将只讲一次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices, Mark A, B, C and D.
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案,马克A、B、C和D。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are many factors that impact our health.
lines.translation: 有许多因素影响我们的健康。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These include our finances, our emotions and the way we work.
lines.translation: 其中包括我们的财政、感情和工作方式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Education is one such factor.
lines.translation: 教育就是这样的一个因素。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Research suggests that higher levels of education can lead to better health and even greater longevity.
lines.translation: 研究表明,提高教育水平可以改善健康,甚至延长寿命。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But what about the education of your partner?
lines.translation: 但是你的伴侣的教育呢?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: New research seeks to answer this question.
lines.translation: 新的研究试图回答这个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Researchers use data from a longitudinal study.
lines.translation: 研究人员使用纵向研究的数据。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The data came from surveys first administered to high school seniors in 1957.
lines.translation: 这些数据来自1957年首次向高中高年级学生进行的调查。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The surveys ended in 2011.
lines.translation: 调查于2011年结束。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The team found that a person whose spouse had a higher level of education tended to report better health.
lines.translation: 调查组发现,其配偶受教育程度较高的人往往报告健康状况较好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This remained the case when adjusting for other factors, such as participants' own education, social background and health status before and after marriage.
lines.translation: 在根据其他因素进行调整时,情况仍然如此,如参与者自己的教育、社会背景和婚前和婚后健康状况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The authors suggest that high levels of education provide shared social, intellectual, emotional and financial resources.
lines.translation: 提交人认为,高水平的教育可提供共享的社会、智力、情感和财政资源。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These include things like higher levels of emotional intelligence, particular skills or knowledge, or more money.
lines.translation: 其中包括诸如更高层次的情感智能、特殊技能或知识,或更多钱。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The researchers concede that an individual's own level of education is clearly important for their health, but they assert that individuals also can reap the benefits of their partner's education.
lines.translation: 研究人员承认,个人自己的教育水平显然对其健康很重要,但他们认为,个人也可以从其伴侣的教育中获益。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is noteworthy that the effects vary by gender.
lines.translation: 值得注意的是,其影响因性别而异。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For women, health was more closely correlated to their spouse's education than for men.
lines.translation: 对妇女而言,健康与其配偶的教育相比与男子的教育更密切相关。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The team suggests this may be related to the time period of the study.
lines.translation: 小组建议这可能与研究的时间有关。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Women in this sample had lower levels of education and lower occupational achievements than the men.
lines.translation: 在抽样中,妇女受教育程度较低,职业成就低于男子。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The researchers' hypothesis is that this made the husband's resources more likely to have a shared impact.
lines.translation: 研究人员的假设是,这使得丈夫的资源更有可能产生共同的影响。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Climate scientists predict that many parts of the world will be increasingly prone to floods.
lines.translation: 气候科学家预测，世界许多地区将越来越容易发生洪水。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is a serious risk to human lives and property.
lines.translation: 这对人类生命和财产构成严重风险。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So understanding and accurately forecasting flood risks is a key challenge for vulnerable cities around the globe.
lines.translation: 因此，了解并准确预测洪水风险，是全球易受影响城市面临的关键挑战。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In 2017, Derek Loftis of the Virginia Institute of Marine Science started a project called Catch the King.
lines.translation: 2017年，弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的德里克·洛夫蒂斯启动了一个名为“Catch the King”的项目。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It uses a smartphone app to collect the data of ordinary citizens during high tides.
lines.translation: 该项目利用一款智能手机应用，在高潮期间收集普通市民提供的数据。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He'll use those data to validate and improve his mathematical flooding model, called TideWatch.
lines.translation: 他将利用这些数据验证并改进自己的数学洪水模型，该模型名为“TideWatch”。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Loftis's mission is to know where the water goes before it goes there.
lines.translation: 洛夫蒂斯的使命，是在水流到某处之前弄清楚它将流向哪里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But collecting necessary data and then processing that information quickly enough to make usable forecasts is anything but easy.
lines.translation: 然而，收集必要的数据，并随后足够迅速地处理这些信息，以便做出可用的预报，绝非易事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Accurate flood forecasts require an understanding of the situation on the ground.
lines.translation: 准确的洪水预报需要了解地面实际情况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: By the early 2000s, supercomputing had advanced enough that scientists could integrate weather forecasting models with such measurements.
lines.translation: 到21世纪初，超级计算技术已经发展到足以让科学家将天气预报模型与此类测量数据结合起来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But they still didn't have the critically important ability to forecast fast-moving floods in real time.
lines.translation: 但他们仍然不具备实时预测快速移动洪水这一至关重要的能力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So, in 2017, Loftis and colleagues set up a group of 28 Internet-connected water-level sensors throughout the flood risk community of Norfolk, Virginia.
lines.translation: 因此，2017年，洛夫蒂斯和同事在弗吉尼亚州诺福克的洪水风险社区内设置了一个由28个联网水位传感器组成的网络。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The new sensors relayed rough measurements about water height and movement to a computer at the Virginia Institute.
lines.translation: 新传感器将有关水位高度和移动情况的粗略测量结果传送到弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的一台计算机上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Along with those sensors, hundreds of local citizens take photos of rising tides and transmit them in real time to the institute.
lines.translation: 除了这些传感器之外，数百名当地市民还拍摄潮水上涨的照片，并将照片实时传送给该研究所。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Scientists hope that the data collected by these citizens can help sharpen the ability to forecast exactly when and where damaging floods will occur.
lines.translation: 科学家希望，这些市民收集的数据能够帮助提高预测能力，从而准确预报破坏性洪水将在何时何地发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题12至15是根据你们刚才听到的段落提出的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 12.
lines.translation: 问题12。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What is said to be a key challenge for cities prone to floods?
lines.translation: 哪些是易发生洪水的城市面临的主要挑战?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For what purpose does Derek Loftus collect the data of ordinary citizens during high tides?
lines.translation: Derek Loftus在潮汐期间收集普通公民的数据是为了什么目的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 14.
lines.translation: 问题14。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does the passage say is Derek Loftus's mission?
lines.translation: 通道上写什么 德里克・洛夫特斯的使命?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 15.
lines.translation: 问题15。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What did Loftus and his colleagues do to obtain data about water hype and movement?
lines.translation: Loftus及其同事为获得有关水的旋律和移动的数据做了哪些工作?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Section C,
lines.translation: C节,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section, you will hear three recordings of lectures or talks, followed by three or four questions.
lines.translation: 在本节中,各位将听取三场讲座或会谈录音,然后是三四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The recordings will be played only once.
lines.translation: 录音只播放一次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C and D.
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案,这四个选择分别是A、B、C和D。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Recording one.
lines.translation: 记录一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree.
lines.translation: 现在,它变成了一种仪式 来辩论大学学位的价值

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This decline began in the 1960s and has become more serious over time.
lines.translation: 这种下降始于20世纪60年代，并且随着时间推移变得更加严重。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What has actually caused this decline?
lines.translation: 究竟是什么导致了这种下降？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, economists have been working to ascertain the roots of the decline for decades and have come up with several theories.
lines.translation: 几十年来，经济学家一直在努力探究其根源，并提出了几种理论。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: One popular theory is that it's a case of too low wages for jobs that don't require a degree.
lines.translation: 一种流行的理论认为，这是因为不要求大学学位的工作薪资过低。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: An alternate theory is that there were more jobs not requiring a college degree in the past than now.
lines.translation: 另一种理论则认为，过去不要求大学学位的工作比现在更多。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A recent working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research reviewed those theories and put forward additional hypotheses about the causes of the problem.
lines.translation: 美国国家经济研究局最近的一篇工作论文审视了这些理论，并进一步提出了有关这一问题成因的其他假设。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Let's look at that paper now.
lines.translation: 现在让我们来看看这篇论文。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: First, the researchers considered the issue of wages.
lines.translation: 首先，研究人员考察了工资问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As the wage gap has grown between those with college degrees and those without, economists have suggested that men aren't as interested in taking some of the less lucrative jobs.
lines.translation: 由于大学毕业者与未获得大学学位者之间的工资差距不断扩大，经济学家认为，男性对从事一些收入较低的工作不再那么感兴趣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While the authors of the paper found truth in this explanation, they assert that low wages can't be the only factor, as wages for men without college degrees, adjusting for inflation, haven't changed much since the 1960s, making it hard to see why fewer men seem willing to accept those wages.
lines.translation: 虽然论文作者发现这种解释有一定道理，但他们断言，低工资不可能是唯一因素，因为没有大学学位男性的工资按通货膨胀调整后，自20世纪60年代以来并没有太大变化，这使人们难以理解为什么似乎有更少的男性愿意接受这样的工资。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This leads to the second theory, that more jobs require a college degree today than in the past.
lines.translation: 这就引出了第二种理论，即如今比过去有更多的工作要求求职者拥有大学学位。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Indeed, that theory seems valid, because in America today, 2/3 of jobs are filled by workers with at least some college education.
lines.translation: 事实上，这一理论似乎是成立的，因为在今天的美国，三分之二的工作由至少接受过部分大学教育的劳动者担任。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, the authors of the paper argue that there are other factors amplifying the problem.
lines.translation: 然而，论文作者认为，还有其他因素加剧了这一问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They identified two new potential explanations: the first being the tremendous decline in marriage among men without college degrees since the 1960s; and the second being the increase in women participating in the workforce that was concurrent with the decline in marriage.
lines.translation: 他们找出了两种新的潜在解释：第一，自20世纪60年代以来，没有大学学位男性的结婚率大幅下降；第二，女性参与劳动力市场的比例有所上升，而这一变化与结婚率下降同时发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These two changes mean that men might not have families to support, or if they do, their wives might be doing more of the providing, both of which might remove the financial incentive to work.
lines.translation: 这两种变化意味着，男性可能没有需要供养的家庭；即使有，他们的妻子也可能承担了更多供养家庭的责任，而这两种情况都可能削弱男性工作的经济激励。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The authors of the paper concede that research on the subject isn't complete, but they argue that their work supports the value of a college education.
lines.translation: 论文作者承认，对这一问题的研究尚未完成，但他们认为，其研究成果支持接受大学教育的价值。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 16.
lines.translation: 问题16。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does the speaker say has become something of a ritual?
lines.translation: 发言者说什么已成为一种仪式?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What did the researchers of a recent working paper consider first?
lines.translation: 最近一份工作文件的研究人员首先审议了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 18.
lines.translation: 问题18。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What did the recent paper identify as a new potential explanation of the problem concerning men's employment?
lines.translation: 最近的文件对男子就业问题提出了什么新的潜在解释?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Recording 2.
lines.translation: 记录2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While an increasing number of people are trying to eat less meat, a market research team has found in its latest fashion and sustainability report that the trend is now spreading from kitchen to closet.
lines.translation: 尽管越来越多的人正在努力少吃肉，但一个市场研究团队在其最新的时尚与可持续发展报告中发现，这一趋势如今正从厨房蔓延到衣柜。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It found animal welfare came top of a list of issues that people considered before buying clothes, with 42% saying it was important to them.
lines.translation: 报告发现，在人们购买服装前考虑的一系列问题中，动物福利位居首位，42%的人表示这对他们很重要。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear designated as "vegan", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.
lines.translation: 该团队的研究人员预测，明年不使用动物材料的鞋类系列将迎来蓬勃发展，因为他们听到各个年龄段的消费者都表示愿意购买标有“纯素”字样的鞋类，这意味着这些商品的生产没有使用任何动物或动物的一部分。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does convey an important extra distinction.
lines.translation: 除了符合潮流，而且比“合成皮革”听起来悦耳得多之外，“纯素”这一标签确实传达了一个重要的额外区别。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If you label something as vegan, then the whole product needs to be animal free.
lines.translation: 如果将某件商品标为纯素，那么整件产品都必须不含动物成分。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That means checking things like the glue that holds the shoe together, for example, and the chemicals used for finishing them.
lines.translation: 这意味着，例如，需要检查用于粘合鞋子的胶水，以及用于进行表面处理的化学品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the top end, some of the world-renowned fashion designers have avoided leather and fur for some time.
lines.translation: 在高端领域，一些世界知名的时装设计师已经有一段时间不再使用皮革和皮草。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In fact, some of the companies are now exploring a leather substitute and a silk replacement made from mushrooms.
lines.translation: 事实上，其中一些公司如今正在探索用蘑菇制成的皮革替代品和丝绸替代品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products registered with the vegan trademark.
lines.translation: Animal Free Product Society表示，他们看到注册纯素商标的产品数量激增。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In 2018, there were 119.
lines.translation: 2018年，这类产品有119件。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So far this year, it says an unprecedented 1,956 have been registered.
lines.translation: 截至今年目前为止，该协会称已有创纪录的1,956件产品完成注册。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: New products are being added daily.
lines.translation: 每天都有新产品加入其中。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are fur coats that are vegan, plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or natural rubber labelled vegan.
lines.translation: 标为纯素的产品包括皮草大衣、塑料制纯素腰带，以及用树皮或天然橡胶制成的鞋子。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These new products aren't coming at an extra cost to consumers though.
lines.translation: 不过，这些新产品并没有让消费者承担额外费用。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Vegan boots cost the same as the leather originals.
lines.translation: 纯素靴子的价格与原皮革靴子相同。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: New Look, one of the first reputable store chains to use the vegan trademark, prices ballet shoes at £7.99 and a vegan laptop handbag at £29.99, comparable with its other products.
lines.translation: New Look是最早使用纯素商标的知名连锁店之一，其芭蕾舞鞋售价为7.99英镑，纯素笔记本电脑手提包售价为29.99英镑，与其他产品的价格相当。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This signifies a change.
lines.translation: 这标志着一种变化。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In the past, ethical products, whether they were fair trade or organic, came at a premium.
lines.translation: 过去，无论是公平贸易产品还是有机产品，伦理类商品的价格都更高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, it is unclear whether these new products can be considered ethical.
lines.translation: 然而，这些新产品是否可以被视为符合伦理标准，尚不明确。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The debate over durability, crop-growing impacts, pollution and recyclability is a complicated one, not to mention the ethics around the working conditions for people making the products, whatever the component materials.
lines.translation: 关于耐用性、作物种植的影响、污染和可回收性的争论十分复杂，更不用说无论所用材料为何，生产这些产品的工人的工作条件所涉及的伦理问题了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Environmental campaigners advise that the best approach is to buy less, never mind what the item is made of.
lines.translation: 环保人士建议，最好的做法是少买东西，不管商品是由什么制成的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 19-21 are based on the recording you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题19 -21是基于你刚才听到的录音

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.translation: 19. 经济

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: has a market research team found in its latest fashion and sustainability report?
lines.translation: 市场研究小组在最新的时尚和可持续性报告中 发现了吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What have some world-renowned fashion designers done for some time?
lines.translation: 一些世界知名的时尚设计师 做了一段时间吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does the speaker say is unclear concerning vegan products?
lines.translation: 发言者说关于素食产品有什么不清楚之处?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.translation: 3 个

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: By the end of 2016, anyone who had been paying even passing attention to the news headlines was highly likely to conclude that everything was terrible and that the world was going to hell.
lines.translation: 到2016年底，任何哪怕只是偶尔关注新闻头条的人，都极有可能得出这样的结论：一切都糟透了，世界正走向毁灭。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It was easy to feel depressed by the wars in different parts of the world, the spread of deadly viruses or terror attacks.
lines.translation: 世界各地的战争、致命病毒的传播或恐怖袭击，很容易让人感到沮丧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yet, 2016 was the best year in the history of humanity.
lines.translation: 然而，2016年却是人类历史上最好的一年。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Child mortality was roughly half what it was as recently as 1990.
lines.translation: 儿童死亡率大约只有就在1990年时的一半。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And 300,000 more people gained access to electricity each day.
lines.translation: 每天还有30万人获得了用电的机会。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Every single measure of material and environmental welfare in America, Europe, Asia, Africa and the world as a whole has improved rather than deteriorated.
lines.translation: 在美国、欧洲、亚洲、非洲以及全世界范围内，衡量物质和环境福祉的每一项指标都在改善，而不是恶化。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We are living in history's most peaceful era, with violence of all kinds in steep decline.
lines.translation: 我们正生活在人类历史上最和平的时代，各种形式的暴力都在急剧减少。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Those are the facts.
lines.translation: 这些都是事实。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So why aren't we all optimists?
lines.translation: 那么，我们为什么没有全都成为乐观主义者呢？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In a 2015 survey for YouGov, 65% of British people and 81% of the French said they thought the world was getting worse.
lines.translation: 在YouGov于2015年进行的一项调查中，65%的英国人和81%的法国人表示，他们认为世界正在变得越来越糟。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, according to numerous sensible statistics, these people are simply wrong.
lines.translation: 然而，根据大量合理的统计数据，这些人的看法显然是错误的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nobody in their right mind should wish to have lived in a previous century.
lines.translation: 任何心智正常的人都不应希望自己生活在过去的某个世纪。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yet people do.
lines.translation: 然而，人们确实会有这样的愿望。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why?
lines.translation: 为什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our prevailing mood of despair is irrational.
lines.translation: 我们普遍的绝望情绪是不理性的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It says more about us than it does about how things really are.
lines.translation: 它更多地反映了我们自身，而不是事物真实的状况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is best explained as the result of various psychological biases that served a purpose for our evolutionary ancestors—but now, in a media-saturated era, constantly mislead us.
lines.translation: 对这种情绪最好的解释是：它源于各种曾为我们进化时期的祖先发挥过作用的心理偏差，但如今在媒体充斥的时代，这些心理偏差却不断误导我们。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Once upon a time, it was of great survival value to be worried about everything that could go wrong.
lines.translation: 曾几何时，对所有可能出错的事情保持担忧具有极大的生存价值。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is what makes bad news especially compelling.
lines.translation: 正因如此，坏消息尤其引人关注。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In our evolutionary past, it was a very good thing that our attention could be easily seized by negative information, since it might well indicate a dangerous risk to our own survival.
lines.translation: 在我们的进化史中，我们的注意力很容易被负面信息吸引是一件非常有益的事，因为这些信息很可能意味着对自身生存构成的危险。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The caveman who always assumed there was a lion behind the next rock would usually be wrong, but he'd be much more likely to survive and reproduce than one who always assumed the opposite.
lines.translation: 那个总是假定下一块岩石后面有一头狮子的穴居人通常会判断错误，但与总是假定情况相反的人相比，他存活并繁衍后代的可能性要大得多。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But that was all before newspapers, television and the internet.
lines.translation: 但那是在报纸、电视和互联网出现以前。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In today's hyper connected times, our addiction to bad news just leads us to vacuum up depressing or enraging stories from across the globe.
lines.translation: 如今，在这个高度互联的时代，我们对坏消息的沉迷只会让我们从全球各地吸纳令人沮丧或愤怒的故事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Whether these news stories threaten us or not, we conclude that things are much worse than they actually are.
lines.translation: 无论这些新闻是否真的对我们构成威胁，我们都会得出这样的结论：事情比实际情况糟糕得多。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Really good news, on the other hand, can be a lot harder to spot in a newspaper because predictable daily events by definition aren't news.
lines.translation: 另一方面，真正的好消息在报纸上往往更难被发现，因为可预见的日常事件按定义来说并不算新闻。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What does our prevailing mood of despair indicate?
lines.translation: 我们普遍存在的绝望情绪意味着什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 25 What was a very good thing in our evolutionary past?
lines.translation: 问题25 我们进化的过去有什么好东西?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's the end of listening comprehension.
lines.translation: 听觉理解到此结束
